    MILNE'S STEP 2 CLOSED: the descent needs NO birational-inverse API, only a section and a retraction
    
    exists_unique_descent_of_birational (Albanese/AlbaneseFromData.lean, sorry-free,
    axiom-clean). This is the descent datum 'hdesc' of
    exists_unique_albanese_factorisation, produced from exactly what Milne III.5.1(a)
    supplies -- so the second of the leg's two remaining inputs is now a named,
    elementary hypothesis rather than an open problem.
    
    WHAT CHANGED CONCEPTUALLY. Every prior docstring in this cone said the step was
    blocked because 'mathlib at this pin has no API for inverting a birational
    morphism (Birational/{RationalMap,Dominant} give IsDominant, not an inverse)'.
    That is true and it does not matter: one never needs to INVERT f^(g). What the
    argument uses is
        s : V -> S  with  s >> f = V.iota          (a section over a dense open)
        f|_{f^-1 V} >> s = (f^-1 V).iota           (and s is a retraction there)
        V dense in J, f^-1 V dense in S
    all of which birationality hands over directly. No inverse is constructed anywhere.
    
    THE SHAPE THAT MATTERS, and why this is not a restatement of DenseOpenDescent:
    the conclusion is an equation on ALL of S,
        exists-unique psi,  h = f >> psi,
    not merely on V. extend_to_av gives it on V; the retraction plus density of
    f^-1 V transports agreement to all of S by ext_of_isDominant (S reduced, A
    separated). That gap between 'agrees on V' and 'agrees on S' is precisely what
    the connector consumes, and closing it is the content here.
    
    Module header corrected accordingly -- including retiring the
    'no birational-inverse API' framing, which would have kept sending sessions to
    look for a mathlib feature the proof does not require.

    blocked because 'mathlib at this pin has no API for inverting a birational
    morphism (Birational/{RationalMap,Dominant} give IsDominant, not an inverse)'.

    argument uses is
        s : V -> S  with  s >> f = V.iota          (a section over a dense open)

        V dense in J, f^-1 V dense in S

    the conclusion is an equation on ALL of S,

    f^-1 V transports agreement to all of S by ext_of_isDominant (S reduced, A
    separated). That gap between 'agrees on V' and 'agrees on S' is precisely what
    the connector consumes, and closing it is the content here.

    'no birational-inverse API' framing, which would have kept sending sessions to
    look for a mathlib feature the proof does not require.
